scripts.lint: run-s custom-lint:build root:lint web:lint:fix cdk:lint cdk:lambda-build-dryrun
scripts.web:devw: source ./setup-env.sh ${npm_config_env} && VITE_APP_VERSION=${npm_package_version} pnpm --filter packages/web run dev
scripts.web:build:analyze: VITE_APP_VERSION=${npm_package_version} pnpm --filter packages/web run build -- --mode analyze
scripts.cdk:deploy:quick: pnpm --filter packages/cdk run cdk deploy -- --all --asset-parallelism --asset-prebuild=false --concurrency 3 --method=direct --require-approval never --force
scripts.cdk:deploy:quick:hotswap: pnpm --filter packages/cdk run cdk deploy -- --all --asset-parallelism --asset-prebuild=false --concurrency 3 --method=direct --require-approval never --force --hotswap
scripts.cdk:deploy:tenant: pnpm --filter packages/cdk run cdk -- --app 'npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/generative-ai-use-cases-tenant.ts' deploy --all
scripts.cdk:diff:tenant: pnpm --filter packages/cdk run cdk -- --app 'npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/generative-ai-use-cases-tenant.ts' diff
scripts.cdk:destroy:tenant: pnpm --filter packages/cdk run cdk -- --app 'npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/generative-ai-use-cases-tenant.ts' destroy --all
scripts.extension:devw: source ./setup-env.sh && cd browser-extension && pnpm run dev
scripts.extension:buildw: source ./setup-env.sh && cd browser-extension && pnpm run build
